ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 45% high-intensity (white) pixels and 55% low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white regions located distally on both lobes. Left lobe contains a broad triangular white region extending from the tip toward the midline with dense internal black mottling. Right lobe contains a concentrated white region along the upper trailing edge and distal tip, bordered by solid black near the peduncle connection.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Significant serration profile with irregular peaks and valleys. Right lobe displays larger-amplitude, low-frequency 'scalloped' indentations. Left lobe displays higher-frequency, smaller-amplitude jagged peaks along the distal third of the edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to elongated, upward-tapering distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity, circular pixel groups (barnacles) localized at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, creating a textured, high-relief appearance.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, vertical low-intensity linear disruptions visible within the white pigmentation of the left lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense barnacle colonization on the distal corners of both lobes; irregular notch present on the trailing edge of the right lobe approximately two-thirds from the center.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy 'salt-and-pepper' mottling within the white patches, particularly dense on the interior boundary of the left lobe white region.
